title: Fix staff access to the Attendance Register

requirements.text: Ensure the Attendance Register is accessible to non-admin staff users: staff must be able to open the “Attendance” tab and view workers and attendance records without authorization traps; only admin-only actions (adding workers, marking attendance) should remain restricted.

quotes: I cannot see the attendance register for staff. Can you fix that

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as a non-admin (staff) user, the Dashboard shows the “Attendance” tab and it renders without a blank screen or infinite loading.
As a non-admin (staff) user, the Attendance tab can successfully fetch and display workers and attendance records (or the empty-state message if none exist).
As a non-admin (staff) user, “Add Worker” and “Mark Attendance” controls remain hidden/disabled (admin-only), consistent with current UI intent.
As an admin user, existing Attendance functionality (add worker, mark attendance, view data) continues to work.

requirements.text: Backend authorization fix: update backend authorization logic so that authenticated staff principals have the required “user” permissions to call user-level endpoints used by Attendance (at minimum: getWorkers, getAttendanceRecords, getWorkerAttendance, getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) while still preventing anonymous access and keeping admin-only endpoints restricted.

quotes: I cannot see the attendance register for staff. Can you fix that

acceptanceCriteria: Calling getWorkers/getAttendanceRecords/getWorkerAttendance as a logged-in non-admin principal succeeds (no Unauthorized trap).
Anonymous caller access remains denied for user-level endpoints (Unauthorized).
Admin-only methods (e.g., addWorker, markAttendance) remain denied for non-admin users (Unauthorized).

requirements.text: Frontend resilience: in the Attendance tab, add a clear user-facing error state (English text) when attendance-related queries fail (e.g., due to authorization), instead of silently showing empty data; include guidance to re-login and/or contact an admin if access is missing.

quotes: I cannot see the attendance register for staff. Can you fix that

acceptanceCriteria: If attendance-related queries error, the Attendance tab shows an error message that indicates the register could not be loaded and provides next steps (re-login/contact admin).
If attendance-related queries succeed but there is no data, the existing empty-state messaging remains (not replaced by the error state).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead).
nonGoals: Adding new attendance features (exports, summaries, payroll calculations).
Introducing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity).
